headline: David George Gordon, Apostle for Bugs on the Dinner Plate, Dies at 76
context: His “The Eat-a-Bug Cookbook” made a case for insects as food, while his boisterous cooking demonstrations brought tarantulas and crickets to TV.

sources.name: The New York Times
